diagnosis.failure_mode: The policy network is not being updated during training. While the policy loss is computed (extremely close to zero), the policy parameters remain frozen. This is evidenced by: (1) clipfrac staying at 0.0 throughout training (indicating no policy changes large enough to trigger clipping), (2) approx_kl staying at 0.0 (no divergence between old and new policy), (3) entropy remaining constant at ln(2)≈0.693 (indicating a static policy), and (4) policy_loss being nearly zero consistently. Meanwhile, the value function is updating normally (value_loss is significant). This suggests the policy optimizer step is either not being executed or the gradients are not being backpropagated to the policy network parameters.
